LanguageData.NR_NetSizeTip_Small: About 24 hubs, three corporations. A tight net: everything is close, the corporations take a bigger share.
LanguageData.NR_NetSizeTip_Normal: About 32 hubs, three corporations, every district including the Campus.
LanguageData.NR_NetSizeTip_Large: About 41 hubs, four corporations, more nodes in every district. The farthest hub is still about 6 hours from Home. Recommended.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsMapSizeTip: Size of the cyberspace map in new games. The game asks again when the colony first enters the net; the layout comes from the world seed.
LanguageData.NR_NetFoundIntro: The colony has found its way into the net. This world's net is laid out as a {0}. Pick its size: it stays for the whole game.
LanguageData.NR_NetFoundPrompt: The net has not been mapped yet.
LanguageData.NR_NetFoundNote: The size can be changed in the mod settings for future games.
LanguageData.NR_MapRunnersChipTip: Netrunners connected to the net from cyberpods. Each walks the map on their own.
LanguageData.NR_MapConnectTip: The netrunner in the pod connects at Home. Walking the net takes game time: about an hour per link, half that on fast lines.
LanguageData.NR_MapNotReady: The net has not been mapped yet.
LanguageData.NR_MapNoPodPawn: Nobody is lying in a powered cyberpod.
LanguageData.NR_MapGoTip: The selected runner walks the shortest route. The game keeps running; a message comes on arrival.
LanguageData.NR_MapExitTip: A clean exit at an exit point or Home: the pod wakes the runner, nothing else.
LanguageData.NR_MapNotAtExit: Only at an exit point or Home.
LanguageData.NR_MapEmergencyTip: Disconnect right now, anywhere: Netsick +{0}, cyberspace nausea, {1} chance of a lockout. Aegis or a Warden AI halve it.
LanguageData.NR_MapEmergencyConfirm: Pull {0} out of the net right now? It hurts.
LanguageData.NR_MapJumpTip: Connect straight at this exit point instead of Home.
LanguageData.NR_MapRouteLost: {0} lost the way: the route broke.
LanguageData.NR_MapTollUnpaid: {0} stopped at a toll link: no cyberdata to pay.
LanguageData.NR_MapPatrolHit: An ICE patrol at {1} caught {0} passing through.
LanguageData.NR_MapBranchOffline: The node is offline right now.
LanguageData.NR_MapNeedRunnerHere: A connected runner has to stand at this hub.
LanguageData.NR_MapNewsMaintenance: Planned maintenance around {NODE}: links down for a day.
LanguageData.NR_MapNewsTransit: A transit window at {NODE}: links through it are instant.
LanguageData.NR_MapNewsToll: A toll goes up on a link at {NODE}.
LanguageData.NR_MapNewsBackdoor: Someone opened a backdoor between {NODE} and {OTHER}.
LanguageData.NR_MapNewsDarkLink: A tunnel leaked on a forum: a dark link near {NODE}.
LanguageData.NR_MapNewsCableCut: A cable broke at {NODE}; the net rebuilt around it.
LanguageData.NR_MapNewsNewNode: The net grows: a new hub, {NODE}.
LanguageData.NR_MapNewsWall: The Wall has a gate now: the Old Net is open.
LanguageData.NR_MapWall: With a corporate core broken, the old gates in the Wall answer for the first time. Beyond them lies the Old Net: ancient systems behind Black ICE 10, with legendary loot.
LanguageData.NR_MapWallLocked: The Wall: the way into the Old Net is shut.
LanguageData.NR_MapSearchHint: Find a hub, node or corp… (F)
LanguageData.NR_MapMinimapTip: The whole net. The frame is what you see; click to jump. Keys: H home, R or Tab next runner, 0 whole map, F search.
LanguageData.NR_MapLensTip_Overview: Overview (1): hubs in their district colours; with a runner standing still, where it can step now.
LanguageData.NR_MapLensTip_Loot: Loot (2): the best haul known at each hub.
LanguageData.NR_MapLensTip_Danger: Danger (3): ICE and gates, patrols and fortresses.
LanguageData.NR_MapLensTip_Corps: Corps (4): corporate ground in each corporation's colour.
LanguageData.NR_MapLensTip_Contracts: Jobs (5): contract targets and your watchlist.
LanguageData.NR_MapLensTip_Time: Time (6): hours of travel from the selected runner.
LanguageData.NR_MapCardClicks: Click: select · double click or Shift: send the runner · Shift on a moving runner: waypoint · right click: menu
LanguageData.NR_MapMenuWaypoint: Add a waypoint (continue from the route's end)
